data.title: Verona
data.about:
Introducing Verona at Damac Hills 2 – an exceptional and dynamic development by Damac Properties, offering a stunning collection of 4-bedroom townhouses designed for unparalleled service and comfort. Experience luxury and serenity amidst the captivating water town, where contemporary living reaches new heights. Nestled strategically in Dubai, Damac Hills 2 is a thoughtfully planned community that grants residents effortless access to key city areas. 

Located just a short drive from major business districts, entertainment hubs, and world-class shopping destinations, it seamlessly harmonizes work and leisure for its privileged inhabitants. The townhouses at Verona boast architectural brilliance, blending modern aesthetics with timeless sophistication. Each residence has been meticulously crafted with a keen eye for detail, ensuring spacious living areas, ample natural light through large windows, and exquisitely landscaped gardens that foster a tranquil atmosphere. Embrace a lifestyle that epitomizes luxury and modern living like no other.

location_tile.title: Welcome to the epitome of luxurious living – Verona at Damac Hills 2, Dubai.
location_tile.description:
Nestled in one of the most desirable areas in the city, this exquisite development enjoys a prime location that will captivate your senses from the moment you step foot in it. Discover a seamless lifestyle as Verona offers easy access to major thoroughfares and nearby communities, ensuring swift commuting to your favourite destinations. Immerse yourself in the excitement of being close to Damac Hills, Downtown Dubai, and many entertainment hubs, providing every moment is filled with convenience and delight.

Experience the best of both worlds as Verona provides a serene haven away from the bustling city, allowing you to unwind in peace. Yet, you won’t have to compromise on any urban amenities, as top-notch schools, healthcare facilities, shopping centres, and entertainment options are just a stone’s throw away. Picture yourself in this idyllic setting, where luxury meets convenience, and tranquillity meets vibrancy. Unlock a lifestyle of dreams and embrace the allure of Verona at Damac Hills 2. Your extraordinary living experience awaits you here.

  • 15 minutes – Jumeirah Village Circle
  • 25 minutes – Dubai Investment Park
  • 30 minutes – Madinat Jumeirah
  • 35 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
  • 37 minutes – Mall of the Emirates
